sub3029: The story starts with blackness,
the main character waking up,
and trying to remember a dream.
She recalls a mirror, a rabbit, and that something was urgent,
but the memories slip from her as she wakes up.
Once awake, she finds a bird perched on her chest.
She tries to pet it
but it flies away.
She looks around and finds herself in a forest laden with mushrooms.
The sun sets..
She discovers a house and
knocks on the door to find an old man.
He initially says nothing to her,
but lets her inside when she asks.
In response to his continued silence, she asks if something's wrong,
after which he finally speaks.
He knows her name and describes her as royalty.
Specifically, she's the heir to the Heart Kingdom.
Some memories come rushing back to her as she realizes the truth about who she is.
The man offers her food, as well as his bed,
but she opts to sleep in the armchair instead.
sub3037: You are slowly waking up from a deep sleep.
You are drifting in and out of reality.
What's that?
A mirror?
A Rabbit.
You go back to sleep.
You wake up again,
and you're in the woods.
It looks like the sun is setting.
It's getting dark.
You seek shelter in a nearby village.
You get to the village, and
knock on the door of a nearby house.
An old man answers the door, and
invites you into his home.
You sit down by the fire in a nearby armchair.
You realise the old man hasn't said anything to you since you sat down.
You ask if your presence is making him uncomfortable.
He answers no, and
that it's just that he doesn't often have royalty in his house.
You respond, "Royalty"?
The old man answers with a "Yes" and
informs you that you are of the house Iratheus.
You are perplexed, and
become excited to learn that you were a sleeping royal, who has woken up.
You start to remember the names Mary-Anne, and pheneus.
You are excited to enjoy your new life as a royal!
